summary: CPU code scan: WHY does cat9 tree-verify diverge from the clean SEQUENTIAL single-forward at the deep-spine node-5 row (num_accepted>1) where native LINEAR MTP-5 does NOT? Every per-forward GDN sub-op matches native (BV A/B scan=0.0, conv-ab=0.0, gate/o_proj native, full-attn within-floor), yet the all-64-layer node-5 verify row diverges 7 logits from the clean forward (gold gate p3 168x; native TF==served, tree TF!=served). The divergence is tree-vs-sequential at deep accept. Scan the code for the TREE-SPECIFIC deep-spine state computation that the linear baseline lacks: GDN recurrent-state handoff across the committed spine inside the batched tree forward, the FA2-fork full-attn tree-mask over the deep spine, tree co-residency. Locate WHERE the tree introduces a divergence the chain does not. NO GPU.

scan.spineStateComputation:
SCAN ALGEBRA — tree vs sequential for node 5 [spine 0->1->3->5], cat9 parent=[-1,0,0,1,1,3,3,5,5] (reconstructed exactly from the patch builder, scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:216-240; node5.ancestors=(0,1,3); spine path0=[0,1,3,5,7]).

TREE-SCAN build of node-5 state (_tree_gdn_kernel, src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:455-527):
- One h0 prior-state load per forward (b_h0, :449-453) read from bank row h0_indices[H0_INDEX_ROW + clamp(num_accepted-1,0)] (:441-448). This is the PRIOR event's committed state — IDENTICAL to what a clean sequential forward of the same accepted prefix starts from.
- Outer tl.static_range over all N_PAD nodes (:459). At i=5 the inner j-loop (:461-467) reads strict_mask[5,j]; ancestors {0,1,3} all set; tl.where(ancestor, h_j, state_i) overwrites in ascending j so the LAST ancestor (j=3) wins -> state_5 = h_cache[3] exactly. h_cache[3] was itself built at i=3 from j=1 (h_cache[1]), node1 from j=0 (h_cache[0]), node0 from b_h0. So the register-resident chain is precisely b_h0 ->node0 ->node1 ->node3 ->node5.
- h_j is selected by tl.sum(tl.where(offs_n==j, h_cache, 0.0), axis=0) (:463-466): zeroes every row but j, sums over N_PAD -> bit-exactly h_cache[j]. The ONLY structural per-edge op a native sequential carry lacks is a -0.0->+0.0 flip introduced once per edge by this select-sum (documented :641-645) — arithmetically inert (-0.0 and +0.0 are identical under *,+,exp), so it cannot carry 7 logits.
- _gdn_node_step (:337-383) is the SINGLE shared rank-1 delta-rule body (state*=exp(g); v-=state.k; v*=beta; state+=v.k; out=state.q) — the identical instruction sequence native fused_recurrent applies per token. The accepted-path replay kernel inlines this SAME body (:353-363) by design.

CLEAN SEQUENTIAL / native-linear build: causal_conv1d_update + fused_recurrent applies the same delta-rule down the CHAIN [0,1,3,5] from the same prior state. Algebraically and (per the tests) bit-exactly equal to the tree-scan trunk: tests/test_fr10_gdn_tree_algebra.py:30 (tree==serial fp32), :80 (appending sibling/leaf does NOT change trunk states, atol=rtol=0.0 -> co-resident branches 2,4,6,8 write only their own h_cache row via tl.where(offs_n==i) at :527 and never touch spine rows {0,1,3,5}), :95 (accepted-path final state == serial native decode).

VERDICT for candidate (a): the GDN recurrent-state handoff across the committed spine inside the batched tree forward is NOT a deep-accept divergence source. The scan recomputes ALL 9 nodes every forward; node-5-from-node-3 is fixed by topology and independent of num_accepted; branch co-residency is proven non-contaminating for the trunk; the prior h0 is shared with the chain. Per-layer GDN scan spine output == native sequential chain (BV A/B D16=D32=0.0). The ~7-logit carrier is therefore NOT in the per-forward GDN scan algebra — it must be the ALL-64-layer accumulation (each layer's bf16/fp8 realization), or candidate (b) full-attn FA2-fork tree-mask / candidate conv prior-window, which Scanner A1 does not rule out but which the scan is not.
scan.divergesAtDeepAccept:
At num_accepted=4 the tree-scan's spine-ancestry state EQUALS the sequential recurrent state — the chunked/ancestry path does NOT diverge for the deep chain at the SCAN level. Reasons, with the precise regime accounting:

WHAT CHANGES at num_accepted=4 vs a shallow accept: (1) WHICH h0 bank column is read — h0_column=clamp(num_accepted-1,0)=3 (:442-446), so a different prior-state row; but that prior state is the SAME state a clean sequential forward of [0,1,3,5] also starts from, so it is not a tree-vs-chain difference. (2) The committer/metadata maps the served reject_correction row to node 5 (the deepest accepted spine node) instead of a shallow node (per FR13_SERVING_PATH_SCAN_BIND.md:11-16). NEITHER changes the per-node scan ALGEBRA: the scan unconditionally computes node5 from node3 every forward regardless of num_accepted (the static_range loop and strict_mask are topology-fixed, num_accepted-independent). So at the SCAN level there is no deep-accept-specific recurrent divergence; the 0->1->3->5 register chain is byte-identical to the sequential chain at any depth.

WHY THE BV A/B MISSED THE LIVE 7-LOGIT DIVERGENCE (it is real but NOT in the scan): the BV A/B capture (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:4124-4138) fires at the FIRST eager forward, fr10_b==0, and the layer-0 linear_attn ONLY (FR13_BV_AB_CAPTURE_LAYER_PREFIX default 'language_model.model.layers.0.linear_attn'), with NO gate on num_accepted. Its native reference (:4171-4199) is fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update run on the path0 chain gathered by index_select(1, path0_nodes) (:4162-4164,4175-4191) — i.e. native runs its own sequential scan on the isolated spine chain, and the bind compares that to OUR full-tree scan's spine rows. The result table (output/fr13_bv_ab/bv_ab_results.json: D16=D32=0.0 at npad1 and npad16, compared_rows=[0,1,2,4,6,8]) therefore validates EXACTLY ONE thing: at ONE layer (L0), our scan's spine rows == native's chain scan. Two blind spots, both confirmed in code/artifacts: (i) ONE LAYER of 64 — the live 7-logit gap is the node-5 row through ALL 64 layers (FR13_SERVING_PATH_SCAN_BIND.md:33-37 'a per-LAYER scan output at one forward ... this 7-logit divergence is the ALL-64-layer node-5 row'); a bit-exact L0 scan still permits per-layer bf16/fp8-realization diffs compounding over ~48 GDN + 16 full-attn layers (reference_diffuse_gdn_accumulation_explained). (ii) The captured forward's num_accepted is whatever the first eager verify produced (typically shallow, 0-1), NOT 4 — but per the analysis above this is immaterial to the SCAN, because the scan algebra is num_accepted-invariant. The BV A/B's fp32-reference cousins in the test suite (tree==serial, sibling-invariance atol=0.0) likewise run in fp32, not the live fp8/bf16 64-layer stack.

CONCLUSION: candidate (a) the GDN recurrent handoff is EXCLUDED as the deep-accept carrier — it is bit-exact to the sequential chain and num_accepted-invariant. The genuine ~7-logit deep-spine row distortion is NOT a fixable scan-algebra seam at num_accepted=4; it is either the all-64-layer per-layer realization accumulation (within-floor-vs-fixable hinges on the per-LAYER ladder finding the FIRST clear-margin layer) or candidate (b) the FA2-fork full-attn TREE_ATTN tree-mask over the deep spine (the one thing structurally absent from native linear MTP-5, FR13_BV_GEOMETRY_NOT_THE_SEAM_BIND.md:42-43,74) or the conv prior-window. Scanner A1's lane is clean: do NOT build a scan/h0/recompute fix — the silicon (D16=D32=0.0) and topology both say the deep-spine recurrent state is already the sequential state.

The FA2 fork adds the ancestry bias to acc_s AFTER QK and BEFORE softmax (scripts/fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py apply_tree_bias :40-73, :59-67), an elementwise add that does not change MMA/reduction order, so the deep-spine node-5 row is byte-exact to native FA2-causal by construction (FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS_FORK.md:9-11). Native E5 (flash_attn.py:840-862) runs causal=True over the LINEAR spine via the same _vllm_fa2_C CUTLASS kernel; the only delta is the reduction-order-invariant bias. The bias matrix is the FIXED tree_len x tree_len tensor built once at init (tree_attn.py:173, reused at verify build :215), not recomputed per accept event, so node-5 attends via the SAME mask at num_accepted=0 or 4. Growing prefix KV (context_len :42) only extends causal context which the bias leaves untouched (k_rel<0 gets no bias = plain causal like native); the bias governs only the tree-suffix sub-block (:57-58). No deep-accept-specific full-attn computation.

scan.isLeadingCarrier: NO - amplifier, not carrier. FR13_VERIFY_DECISIVE_BIND.md:44-60 Q2 substitution: feeding the clean recurrent-oracle residual into the tree real L58 then running its real L59-L63 full_attn gives the CLEAN argmax (Arm A 3425, reverts); zeroing only L0 still flips (Arm C 1970). scan.branchAffectsSpineRow: NO. Branches do NOT affect node-5 row at num_accepted=4 in either op. Leading remaining carrier = the deep-accept cross-event h0 state-feed (fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:442-447 / fr10_phase4_patch:4103-4108); FA2-fork tree-mask exonerated for the spine row by exp(-inf)=0 + the no-bias gate. localize.topCandidate: GDN-recurrent / candidate (a) — but specifically the DIFFUSE per-layer bf16+fp8 realization drift across the tree verify forward (all 48 GDN/linear-attn + 16 full-attn layers), NOT the per-forward GDN scan ALGEBRA (which is bit-exact). Ranking: (a) diffuse-deep-GDN-accumulation = carrier > (b) full-attn FA2 tree-mask = AMPLIFIER-not-carrier (2-ULP floor) > (c) co-residency = EXCLUDED (no bleed). The decisive disambiguation is the Q2 substitution test (FR13_VERIFY_DECISIVE_BIND.md:50-58): splicing the clean recurrent oracle's hidden into the tree at L58 reverts the flip to the clean argmax (so L59-L63 deep full-attn given a clean input return clean = amplifier), while splicing at L0-only still flips (so the seed re-accumulates L1-L58 = diffuse). Co-residency is ruled out structurally: node-5's GDN state reads only its strict ancestors {0,1,3} via the (offs_n==j) select gated by strict_mask, and branch K-columns are hard -inf-masked in full-attn; the only num_accepted=4-specific input is the deep h0 bank column (h0_column=clamp(num_accepted-1,0)=3), but that prior committed state is the SAME state a clean sequential forward of [0,1,3,5] also starts from (a per-request chain quantity native also computes), so it is not a tree-vs-chain difference at the scan level.
localize.fixableOrInherent: FIXABLE-IN-PRINCIPLE but NOT a single named wiring/op seam — it is the within-floor-vs-fixable user decision, currently OVER the floor. Existence proof of fixability (FR13_DIFFUSE_GDN_EXPLAINED.md:24-31): native E5 runs the SAME model, SAME fp8, SAME 64 layers and drifts only 3 clear-margin flips vs the tree's 22 (~7x), so a clean realization provably exists at identical precision — "diffuse" is not a law of nature, it means our per-layer finite-precision realization (fp add non-associativity, cast boundaries, reduction order, Triton num_warps/BV codegen) leans the same way at each layer and compounds, amplified by the gate 1/rms and deep full-attn. It is NOT a per-op fix (conv/scan/gate/o_proj already at the bf16-ULP floor; FA2-fork attn byte-exact ~0.0039) — the one un-closed candidate seam is the GDN scan num_warps=8/BV=16 codegen (vs native 4/BV=32), only ever atol=1e-3-gated.
